name: When should I consider making my bathroom accessible?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider making my bathroom accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider making your bathroom accessible if you or a family member are experiencing mobility challenges, planning for future aging-in-place needs, or recovering from an injury that limits movement. Proactive modifications can prevent falls and improve daily living quality. It's also beneficial if you anticipate needing a wheelchair or walker, ensuring your home remains safe and functional long-term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider accessibility modifications when facing mobility challenges, planning for aging-in-place, or recovering from an injury to improve safety and daily living.
